name: Surveyor 7
intro: Surveyor 7 here! My brothers already proved Apollo can land on the plains.
So scientists said: let's go somewhere WILD. The rim of Tycho, a young, rocky crater.
Help me choose the landing spot.
briefing: Tycho is far south, in the bright highlands.
Pick a site with enough sunlight and Earth in view.
fact: Surveyor 7 saw laser beams fired from Earth: the first laser contact with the Moon.
